channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Zach Collins | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Zach Collins from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Zach Collins, Kevin Huerter
item.description:
Donovan on Bulls’ inability to uphold their playstyle through recent skid:

“I’m not looking at film saying, ‘Oh, Kevin Huerter’s out, Zach Collins is out. Boy, if HE was here, this would be different.’ I don’t believe that. Some of it’s, like, inbounding the basketball. What do these guys being out have to do with that? What is five guys running back in transition, talking and communicating, have to do with anybody being out?”

Billy Donovan on Zach Collins, Kevin Huerter, Dec 10, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jalen Smith on Zach Collins
item.description:
K.C. Johnson:Jalen Smith on loss of Zach Collins:

“Zach is a tremendous player. He’s one of our pillars of physicality. We’ll miss him. I gotta step up.”

Jalen Smith on Zach Collins, Oct 18, 2025. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Victor Wembanyama on Zach Collins
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Wembanyama on Collins' spreading the floor:

“I know it is going to be a lot of trouble for teams trying to guard Zach, especially with our connection... Heis a good shooter... I am glad to see that he has that confidence in (himself). I know it is going to be beautiful.”

Victor Wembanyama on Zach Collins, Oct 7, 2023. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Zach Collins
item.description:
Pop on the latest injury plaguing Zach Collins:

“It’s unfortunate for him and for us, but you just deal with whatever happens, you just move on.”

Gregg Popovich on Zach Collins, Nov 9, 2022. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Zach Collins
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Pop on whether there will be any restrictions on Collins tonight:

“That's a good question. I didn't even ask. I probably should. I will... I don't think so. He's been playing, what, 4 or 5, 6 G League games? I think he's fine.”

Gregg Popovich on Zach Collins, Feb 4, 2022. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Michael Malone on Carmelo Anthony, Damian Lillard, CJ McCollum, Robert Covington, Rodney Hood, Jusuf Nurkic, Zach Collins
item.description:
Michael Malone on the Blazers, Denver's opponent tomorrow:

“I think Portland's really good. Last year they were decimated by injuries. I think Terry does a really good job as their coach. One of the best backcourts in the NBA with CJ McCollum and Damian Lillard, Carmelo Anthony, Jusuf Nurkic. They've got Rodney Hood back. Zach Collins back. They get Robert Covington. They're a good basketball team. I think they're going to have a much better season in the regular season than they had last year because they're going to be healthy.”

Michael Malone on Carmelo Anthony, Damian Lillard, CJ McCollum, Robert Covington, Rodney Hood, Jusuf Nurkic, Zach Collins, Dec 15, 2020. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Neil Olshey on Trevor Ariza, Jusuf Nurkic, Zach Collins
item.description:
Neil Olshey said Wednesday.

“On one hand, I’m excited to see our guys play again. You know, the season ended so abruptly, we were just getting healthy. We were three days from getting ‘Nurk’ (Jusuf Nurkic) back and Zach (Collins) was on the horizon-- he was about three weeks out from returning. At that point, Trevor (Ariza) was in the starting lineup, so the exciting thing is to see the guys out playing basketball again. I missed basketball.”

Neil Olshey on Trevor Ariza, Jusuf Nurkic, Zach Collins, Jul 1, 2020. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Terry Stotts on Joel Przybilla, Zach Collins
item.description:
Kerry Eggers:Terry Stotts on @Zach Collins:

“I was with Joel Przybilla his rookie season in Milwaukee. Zach is a more skilled offensive player, but he reminds me to some degree of Joelas far as his length, his timing, his aggressiveness, his fearlessness.”

Terry Stotts on Joel Przybilla, Zach Collins, Nov 8, 2018. Source: Twitter @kerryeggers.

item.title: Neil Olshey on Zach Collins
item.description:
Jay Allen:Neil Olshey on Zach Collins:

“He's everything you want in a big man in our league today. He can play inside-out.”

Neil Olshey on Zach Collins, Jun 22, 2017. Source: Twitter @PDXjay.
